rounds.prompt: How many people alive today are 100 years old or older?
rounds.source: United Nations World Population Prospects, via Joseph Chamie (former UN Population Division director), IPS News, May 2026: about 672,000 centenarians in 2026

rounds.prompt: How many iPhones are sold worldwide in 100 seconds?
rounds.source: IDC and Omdia smartphone trackers: about 241 to 248 million iPhones shipped in 2025

rounds.prompt: How much money is in a 100 kg (220 lb) stack of $100 bills?
rounds.source: US Bureau of Engraving and Printing: every US banknote, whatever the denomination, weighs about 1 gram
